ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: The data below concerns the general animal body plan of five organisms. Which two organisms are the most closely related?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The image shows an animal body characteristics table, with column headings Characteristic, Sea anemone, Hagfish, Eel, Salamander; row headings Vertebral column, Jaws, Walking legs. The plus signs show: vertebral column is present under hagfish, eel, salamander; jaws is present under sea anemone, eel, salamander; walking legs is present only under salamander. Reasoning: The question asks to find the two organisms that are most closely related. Compare the number of characteristics shared by each pair of organisms; eel and salamander both have vertebral column and jaws, sharing the most characteristics; salamander additionally uniquely has walking legs. Therefore the two closest are eel and salamander.
